description: This file contains code generation functions for registering and generating C++ code for dispatch keys in PyTorch, including structured and unstructured kernel registration, wrapper generation, and device checks.

classes.name: RegisterDispatchKey
classes.description: Class responsible for generating registration code for a specific dispatch key, including wrappers, structured and unstructured kernel registration, and device checks.

classes.name: StructuredRegisterDispatchKey
classes.description: Subclass of RegisterDispatchKey that handles generation of structured kernel registration, including class definitions for structured operators.

methods.name: gen_registration_headers
methods.description: Generates include headers based on the backend dispatch key and options.

methods.name: gen_empty_impl_names
methods.description: Returns the names of the empty tensor implementation functions for a given backend.

methods.name: gen_create_out_helper
methods.description: Generates code for creating output tensors with specified sizes and options.

methods.name: gen_maybe_create_proxy_helper
methods.description: Generates code for creating proxy tensors if strides differ.

methods.name: gen_resize_out_helper
methods.description: Generates code for resizing output tensors.

methods.name: gen_check_inplace_helper
methods.description: Generates code for checking in-place tensor operations.

methods.name: gen_registration_helpers
methods.description: Generates helper code snippets for registration, including creation, resize, check, and proxy helpers.
